# LanDeng (澜灯)

> A quiet, research-led English-language knowledge platform for Chinese botanical incense: its materials, botanicals, history, terminology, craft and culture.

## Core pages

- [Home](/): editorial homepage for LanDeng.
- [Chinese Incense (香 / Xiang)](/chinese-incense/): what Chinese incense is — history, the Four Leisure Arts, and the way of incense (香道).
- [Ingredients](/ingredients/): index of the ingredient encyclopedia.
- [Wholesale](/wholesale/): wholesale inquiries for Chinese botanical incense.
- [OEM & Private Label](/oem/): OEM and private-label development.
- [Contact](/contact/): samples, quotes, wholesale and OEM inquiries.

## Machine-readable data

- [Ingredient dataset](/data/ingredients.json): 82 ingredient entities (Schema.org Dataset / DefinedTerm).
- [Terminology dataset](/data/terminology.json): 104 Chinese–English incense terms (Schema.org Dataset / DefinedTerm).

## AI content notes

- Entity pages expose machine-readable definitions (Chinese term, pinyin, scientific name, type, aroma profile).
- Traditional knowledge and modern evidence are labeled separately.
- No fabricated reviews, ratings, prices or authors appear on this site.
